verdict.rationale: Pigment documents scenarios built on different assumptions and detailed application histories down to the data block level with visibility into edit events. That gives a reasonable basis for auditing changes, but the evidence never ties the history to individual scenarios or says it records who made each change. Missing for 10: explicit per-scenario assumption logging, documented attribution of who changed each assumption, an auditable scenario-comparison view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, each scenario records its assumptions and who changed them, so a comparison is auditable

citations.quote: Run scenarios at the touch of a button to assess different assumptions
your applications each have detailed histories down to the data block level, which offer full visibility into the edit events
